title: Sermons in the admin panel: how the page works
question: AV uploads first, the office does a second pass; the source switch is on the page. Three ways to lay it out, in the admin panel's look. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Review queue
options.thesis: A queue of sermons that need a look beside the one you're checking; Looks right moves to the next.
options.viewport: Title band with Upload a sermon; the source strip; Needs a look (3) on the left, the chosen sermon's fields and Looks right · next on the right.
options.risk: Uploading is a button away rather than on the page; a big tidy-up of old series is slower one at a time.

options.label: Upload workbench
options.lineage: the AV desk on Sunday afternoon
options.thesis: The upload form owns the left; everything that came in is a table on the right with Needs a look and No series filters.
options.viewport: Title band; the source strip; drop zone and form on the left; Recently added table with filters on the right.
options.risk: In the website version the form is idle space; correcting happens in the table's detail.

options.label: Two passes
options.lineage: a pinboard of this week's work
options.thesis: Three columns on a sand board: Just uploaded, Needs a look, Checked this week; cards move across once.
options.viewport: Title band with Upload; the source strip; the three-column board; links to all sermons, series and speakers below.
options.risk: A board needs a 'checked' state we'd record per sermon; the full library is a second page.
